templates.title: MyNeS - My Network Scanner
templates.name: mynes
templates.description: Discovers, identifies and monitors every device on your home network - including the ones an IP scan cannot see. Speaks ARP, mDNS/Bonjour, SSDP/UPnP, Matter, Bluetooth LE and MQTT, so Zigbee2MQTT bulbs, Z-Wave JS sensors, BLE trackers and Tasmota nodes appear next to your servers and phones. Vendor lookup over a 1000+ entry OUI database, topology and graph views, scan history, rule-based alerts by Web Push / webhook / e-mail, and two-way Home Assistant integration. No cloud, no account, no telemetry.
templates.note: Host networking is required for ARP/mDNS/SSDP discovery. NET_ADMIN and NET_RAW let MyNeS send raw ARP frames; without them it falls back to a ping sweep and finds fewer devices. Open http://<host-ip>:5883 after deploy. Only scan networks you own.

env.name: MYNES_MQTT_HOST
env.label: MQTT broker host (optional, reveals Zigbee/Z-Wave devices)
